definitions.explanation: A force or movement that occurs in response to a prior action, often in the opposite direction. Can be physical or metaphorical.
In a political context, opposition to progress or reform, favoring a return to a previous state.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無理|むり}した→無理する：22426_murisuru⟧{反動|はんどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}した→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧。
examples.english: I got sick as a backlash from overworking.

examples.japanese: ⟦ダイエット→ダイエット：17678_daietto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{反動|はんどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べ{過|す}ぎた→食べ過ぎる：21686_tabesugiru⟧。
examples.english: I overate as a rebound from dieting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{反動|はんどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{自由化|じゆうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まった→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: As a backlash against strict regulations, calls for liberalization grew louder.

examples.japanese: {反動|はんどう}⟦{勢力|せいりょく}→勢力：11812_seiryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{台頭|たいとう}→台頭：07595_taitou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{反動|はんどう}{的|てき}な⟦{思想|しそう}→思想：03173_shisou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{反動|はんどう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{保守派|ほしゅは}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{勢力|せいりょく}→勢力：11812_seiryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばした→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧。
examples.english: As a reaction against reform, the conservatives expanded their influence.

notes:
{反動|はんどう} describes a reaction or backlash that occurs in the opposite direction of a prior action. In everyday Japanese, it most commonly refers to a rebound effect — overdoing something after a period of restraint.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{反動|はんどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: as a rebound/backlash from ~
- {反動|はんどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: to experience a rebound/backlash
- {反動|はんどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: the backlash is severe

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ダイエット→ダイエット：17678_daietto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{反動|はんどう}: rebound from dieting
- ⟦{無理|むり}した→無理する：22426_murisuru⟧{反動|はんどう}: backlash from overexertion
- {反動|はんどう}{的|てき}: reactionary (na-adjective)
- {反動|はんどう}⟦{勢力|せいりょく}→勢力：11812_seiryoku⟧: reactionary forces (political)

USAGE:
In everyday conversation, the rebound/backlash sense (sense 1) is far more common. The political sense (reactionary) appears mainly in news and academic writing.
